_help: Airdrop Campaign Planner. Eligibility rules and anti-farming ideas are lists the visitor ticks; {n} in a rule is a number they can change. Tiers split the airdrop between wallet groups (walletPct of eligible wallets get tokenPct of the airdrop). Timeline steps are days after the snapshot. Warnings are rules of thumb, not standards.

rules.text: Used the app at least {n} times before the snapshot
Held at least {n} of a partner or project token at the snapshot
Joined during the first {n} months (testnet, beta or waitlist)
Has a community role earned by helping (moderator, builder, artist)
Made at least {n} dollars of real volume over 30 days or more

anti.text: Count activity over weeks, not one busy day
anti.why: Farmers spin up activity just before a snapshot. Rewarding steady use over time is harder to fake.

anti.text: Require a minimum wallet age and history
anti.why: Fresh wallets made just for the airdrop are a common farming sign.

anti.text: Run a sybil check and publish how it works
anti.why: Look for clusters of wallets funded from the same source that act the same way, and remove them before the claim.

anti.text: Cap the tokens any one wallet can get
anti.why: A cap stops one farmer with many actions taking a big slice.

anti.text: Avoid simple tasks that bots can repeat
anti.why: Follow, like and retweet quests are easy to farm with bot accounts.

anti.text: Offer an optional proof of personhood for a bonus
anti.why: A bonus for verified humans, not a requirement, keeps it open while making farming less rewarding.

anti.text: Run a short appeal window for wrongly flagged users
anti.why: Sybil filters make mistakes. An appeal keeps real users on your side.

methods.label: Equal
methods.line: Every eligible wallet gets the same amount.

methods.label: Tiered
methods.line: More active wallets get more, in three tiers.

methods.label: By activity points
methods.line: Tokens shared in proportion to points. Exact amounts depend on each wallet's points.

warnings.big: Over {n}% of supply in one airdrop is a lot. Many projects keep each season smaller and run more than one.
warnings.short: A claim window under {n} days leaves out people who are away. Many projects give 60 to 90 days.
warnings.anti: Pick at least {n} anti-farming ideas, or farmers may take most of the airdrop.
warnings.noRules: Pick at least one eligibility rule.
warnings.allAtClaim: Everything unlocks at claim. Expect many people to sell on day one; some projects unlock part at claim and the rest over a few months.
